items.text: Cincinnati placed TE Erick All Jr. on IR with a believed torn ACL; TE Tanner Hudson is already out for the season.
Cincinnati S Kyle Dugger re-aggravated his quad and has been ruled out for Sunday. S Bryan Cook was also hurt in the second half against Baltimore (no status).
Tennessee WR Calvin Ridley (hip) and RB Tyjae Spears (knee) were inactive in Week 7; no Week 8 status yet. P Tommy Townsend (knee) was hurt in Week 7.
